# Claude AI

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../), one of its top concepts._

Claude AI LLM (Sonnet or Opus models) that support a PKM system.

## Scope note

- Integrates AI with apps, services, scripts, commands, and agents.
- Generates analysis notes in Obsidian such as Day Diabetes Analysis and Day Analysis using pkm-review services, scripts, commands, and agents.
- Support an AI prompt library and additional dynamic AI chats with PKM system knowledge, context, and memory.
